text: CARDIOLOGY CLINIC NOTE: 64-year-old female with essential Stage 2 hypertension. Initiated Lisinopril 20 mg once daily alongside lifestyle sodium restriction. At 6-week follow-up in Boston, MA, seated blood pressure improved from 158/96 mmHg to 124/78 mmHg. Serum potassium and creatinine remain within normal limits. Patient reports no cough or lightheadedness.
